rv.q: Powerful revival of Tennessee Williams’ classic New Orleans drama
Joanna Vanderham is stunning as Blanche.
This production of A Streetcar Named Desire is just wonderful. With a phenomenal cast and a well put together production, this is definitely not a show to be missed...
This Streetcar is certainly strong in many aspects, but stumbles over certain key points.

cn.t: Sheffield's production of Tennessee Williams' classic earns praise for its intense, expressionistic approach and talented cast, delivering a relevant and potent take on the iconic family drama.
